description:
Maintenance demo master data: a Basic/Tree "Maintenance" with one location
and one production line, carrying three Industry.Basic/Machine entities that
each fill a Basic/NamePlate record (manufacturer, product designation, serial
number).

Data-only - no pipelines, no adapter. Useful as the asset side of a
maintenance or shop-floor demo; connect live signals by adding your own
DataFlow that writes to these machines.

Demo and training tenants only.
